on_screen_text: सत श्री अकाल दोस्तों, मैं त्वनु एक छोटा सा challenge देना हूं। [Hello friends, I want to give you a small challenge.] SpeakEasy AI. Install Now.
summary: An AI avatar challenges viewers to practice English for 15 minutes daily for 7 days using the SpeakEasy app. It highlights features like instant pronunciation correction and judgment-free learning to build confidence, ending with a call to action to download the app.
